demonstrates: the source gate parses every file under apps/web/src with the TypeScript compiler API and reports no violation of ST-A1, ST-A2, ST-A4, ST-A5, ST-A6, ST-A7 or ST-A8; the committed regression suite runs that same checker over 5 accepted fixtures producing zero violations and 8 rejected fixtures each producing its expected rule, file and line with a non-zero exit. Seven mutations written into the real apps/web tree were each detected and are recorded under identity_architecture_gate. The gate enforces defined construction and call patterns and is not information-flow analysis.
